config.statement: Color ${k}$ squares of a ${n} \times {n}$ chessboard, so that there do not exist three colored squares whose centers form a right triangle with sides parallel to the edges of the board.
config.formatting_instructions:
Output the answer between \verb|\begin{array}{...}| and \verb|\end{array}| inside of $\boxed{...}$. For example, $\boxed{\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{array}}$.
Output the chessboard where empty cells "o" are replaced with colored cells "x":

$${init_chessboard}$$
